label: July 20–26, 2026
intro: Chiang Mai moves into theCOMMONS — potters, roasters, and makers from the north settle in for the whole month. Great workshop energy all week long.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshops priced per session
activities.why: Northern Thai potters, cooks, craftspeople, and community makers have taken over the space. Thor can watch live clay work, try a hands-on session, eat khao soi, and poke around handmade objects. Ticks building & making and pottery in one outing.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are quietest — potters and makers are more chatty and hands-on when it's not packed.

activities.title: Roller Dome at Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.why: Southeast Asia's biggest indoor roller rink — perfect for Thor's rollerblading passion. Entry includes 15 minutes of basic instruction and coaches are on hand for tiny beginners. Air-conditioned.
activities.tip: Arrive at opening (11am) to beat the lunch crowd.

activities.title: Neo Land Festival — Final Stretch
activities.why: Last full weekend before this immersive art festival closes. Pair with the riverside promenade and river-taxi snack stop.
activities.tip: Closes July 31 — this is one of the last weekends.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.price: Check Klook for up to 45% off
activities.why: A 2-hectare Marvel universe where Thor trains like Iron Man in Stark's Mobile Lab, tries Flight Training VR, and takes a 360° 4D dome mission with Spiderman and Hulk. Basically built for a 5-year-old Iron Man fan.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are far less crowded. Book via Klook for best price. BTS to On Nut then Grab (~30 min).

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club — Beginner Session
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit
activities.why: Thor loves ice skating — a proper private lesson with an academy coach builds real skills. Quieter weekday afternoons mean more ice time and more coach attention.
activities.tip: One private lesson to build form is worth it before committing to group classes.
